scientific_integrity: Exact formulas proved using signed-permutation extension, set-intersection coupling, binomial inversion; exhaustive small-case verification is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to independent uniform proper admissible-rank factors; maximal-rank absorption is a lattice-phase limit. Historical priority beyond inspected sources is not exhaustive.
title: Signed-intersection convolution and dyadic absorption in symplectic rook monoids
